title: 第3章 龙虎豹第4章 城里的酒
content_zh:
【龙虎豹】。
抬头看着那个白色的崭新招牌，陈冲站定脚步。
转入旁边小巷，陈冲从里面的逼仄入口踏上二楼，扫开门口的珠帘，发出哗啦啦的声音。
珠帘后有一张小桌子，桌旁一张折叠椅，椅子上坐着一个穿军绿大衣的矮胖子，正在拨弄桌下的炭火。
听到声音，胖子抬起头来，推了推鼻梁上的眼镜，露出笑容
“小哥，欢迎。来学拳？”
陈冲看着略显斯文的胖子有些意外，不过他旋即点点头
“我之前看到传单，说前十个报名的可以免费，还包吃住。”
“巧了，你就是第十个。”
胖子眨了眨眼，将桌上的黄皮本子和钢笔推过来
“登记一下吧。叫什么名儿？”
“陈冲。”
陈冲心里松了口气。
没想到过了几天还有名额，运气不错。
要是没有免费学徒当，他就要先想办法搞点钱了。
在本子上登记了自己的基础信息，看到还有父母名字、职业等，他问道
“父母的也要填？”
“当然。我们这儿可是正规拳馆，一切符合利川市管理部门规定的。”
胖子拿起火钳，拍了拍墙上挂着的一张营业执照，在上面留下两道黑灰。
“我们老板的蓝图广大，想在利川一直发展，多开几家，所以不想招些不三不四的人。你们第一批免费学员也是咱们的招牌，免费食宿不说，指导起来肯定是最用心的。当然要多了解些信息。”

陈冲微微点头，心里更踏实了几分。
相比市面上大部分鱼龙混杂的拳馆，显然这种是他更想要的。
不过他还是多留了个心眼，在父母那两栏里写下了亲生父母的名字。
至于电话，没有填。
这年头不要说手机，固话都不是每个家庭都有，传呼机还是主流的移动通讯方式，没填也不足为奇。
看着陈冲登记完，胖子满意的点点头
“很好小陈，现在开始，你就是我们‘龙虎豹’拳馆的正式学徒了。哦，还没说我的名字，你可以叫我豹哥。”
“豹哥，你好。”
陈冲隐晦的打量了一眼豹哥圆润的身材，迟疑道
“我这就算入馆了？不需要测试什么的么？”
免费名额，又要打广告，他以为会有些基本的要求。
豹哥哈哈一声
“当然有！来。”
豹哥领着陈冲绕过隔断，面前是一个大练功室。
这里二楼全部被打通，陈冲记得以前是一个艺考培训机构，这就是之前的舞蹈室。
不过那机构很快就黄了，这里长期空置，现在又租给了龙虎豹拳馆。
有几名学员正在教练的指引下打沙袋或是对练，发出呼喝不停。
陈冲看了几眼，随豹哥走到角落里，看着那跟电玩厅里差不多的拳击器，挑了挑眉。
content_en:
[Dragon Tiger Leopard].
Looking up at the brand new white sign, Chen Chong stood still.
Turning into the alley next to it, Chen Chong stepped onto the second floor from the cramped entrance and swept open the bead curtain at the door, making a clattering sound.
There is a small table behind the bead curtain and a folding chair beside the table. Sitting on the chair is a short fat man in a military green coat, fiddling with the charcoal fire under the table.
Hearing the sound, the fat man raised his head, pushed up his glasses on the bridge of his nose, and smiled.
"Brother, welcome. Come and learn boxing?"
Chen Chong was a little surprised when he looked at the slightly gentle fat man, but he nodded immediately.
"I saw a flyer before, saying that the first ten people to register will be free, and food and accommodation will be included."
"What a coincidence, you are the tenth."
The fat man blinked and pushed the yellow leather notebook and pen on the table over.
"Register me. What's your name?"
"Chen Chong."
Chen Chong felt relieved.
I didn’t expect that there would still be a spot after a few days, so I was lucky.
If there was no free apprenticeship, he would have to find a way to make some money first.
After registering his basic information in the notebook and seeing his parents’ names, occupation, etc., he asked
"Do you also need to fill in the parents' papers?"
"Of course. Ours is a regular boxing gym here, and everything complies with the regulations of the Lichuan City Management Department."
The fat man picked up the poker and patted a business license hanging on the wall, leaving two streaks of black ash on it.
"Our boss has a broad plan. He wants to continue to develop in Lichuan and open more stores, so he doesn't want to recruit some shady people. Your first batch of free students are also our signature. Not to mention free food and accommodation, you must be the most attentive in guiding. Of course, you need to know more information."
Chen Chong nodded slightly, feeling a little more at ease.
Compared to most of the mixed boxing gyms on the market, this is obviously what he wants more.
However, he still paid more attention and wrote the names of his biological parents in the two columns of parents.
As for the phone number, I left it blank.
Not to mention mobile phones these days, not every household has a landline phone, and pagers are still the mainstream mobile communication method, so it is not surprising that it was not filled in.
Watching Chen Chong finish registering, the fat man nodded with satisfaction.
"Very well, Xiao Chen. From now on, you are the official apprentice of our 'Dragon, Tiger and Leopard' boxing gym. Oh, I haven't said my name yet, you can call me Brother Bao."
"Brother Leopard, hello."
Chen Chong took a vague look at Brother Bao's round figure and said hesitantly.
"Am I admitted to the library now? Don't I need to take a test or something?"
With free places and advertising, he thought there would be some basic requirements.
Brother Leopard laughed out loud
"Of course! Come."
Brother Bao led Chen Chong around the partition, and in front of him was a large practice room.
The entire second floor here has been opened up. Chen Chong remembered that it used to be an art exam training institution, and this was the previous dance studio.
However, that institution soon became obsolete. It has been vacant for a long time and is now rented to the Longhubao Boxing Gym.
Several students were playing sandbags or sparring under the guidance of the coach, and they were shouting and shouting.
Chen Chong glanced at it for a few times, followed Brother Bao to the corner, looked at the boxing machine that was similar to that in the video arcade, and raised his eyebrows.
